newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy January diesel, jet fuel.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy January diesel, jet fuel.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to purchase 185,000 barrels of gas oil and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel, industry sources said on Thursday.
The combination cargo of 1.0 percent sulphur gas oil and jet A-1 is for delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo between January 15-16.
The tender closes on December 31 and is valid until January 1, traders said.

CPC bought its last middle distillate cargo from Kuwait-based Independent Petroleum Group at a premium of 69 cents per barrel and at 99 cents per barrel premium for jet fuel, both over Singapore quotes on a c-and-f basis for January 9-10 delivery.
